question: As enshrined in article 168 of Constitution of India, there are two Houses of the Legislature of a State, one shall be known as the ________ and the other as the Legislative Assembly.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Legislative Council**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 168** of the Constitution of India states that when a state has two houses in its legislature, **one house is called the Legislative Council** and the other is called the Legislative Assembly.
 
• If** there is only one house, it is called the Legislative Assemb**ly
 
• The Legislative Assembly is the lower house of the state legislature, and it's a vital part of India's legislative system.
 
• It's composed of directly elected members, with each state having between 60 and 500 members
 
• The **Legislative Council, on the other hand, is the upper house**
 
• **Its composition and powers are outlined in Articles 171 and 172** of the Indian Constitution 
 
• Legislative Council (**also known as the Council of States** or Vidhan Parishad)
 
• Legislative Assembly (**also known as Vidhan Sabha**)
